supporting_text: Gastroscopy showed partial stenosis of the esophageal lumen, likely caused by malignant neoplasm.
Dysphagia to solids and liquids was mentioned, which is commonly associated with esophageal obstruction.
Fever was noted occasionally, which can be associated with esophageal obstruction or infection.
Active smoking is a well-known risk factor for developing esophageal cancer.
The clinical notes did not mention significant weight loss, but it is often seen with dysphagia in various conditions.
